question: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom: An ivory tower
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. A state of privileged seclusion**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"An ivory tower"** refers to a state of seclusion or separation from the real world, often with a connotation of being out of touch with practical realities. (विशेषाधिकार प्राप्त एकांत या अलगाव की स्थिति) • **Example:** Academics are often accused of living in an ivory tower, disconnected from real-world problems. • The correct meaning of the idiom is a situation where someone is detached from everyday life and practical concerns, often surrounded by intellectual or artistic pursuits. (अलग-थलग रहने और व्यावहारिक चिंताओं से दूर रहने की स्थिति) • **Example:** She spent most of her life in an ivory tower, working on abstract theories without considering their real-world applications. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. A state of privileged seclusion**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 2: An expensive building** (महंगा भवन): This refers to a costly structure or construction, but it is not related to the meaning of "An ivory tower." • **Example:** The billionaire built an expensive building in the heart of the city. • **Option 3: A place of hard work** (कड़ी मेहनत का स्थान): This means a location where rigorous labor or effort is performed. It is unrelated to "An ivory tower." • **Example:** The factory is a place of hard work for the employees. • **Option 4: A towering structure** (एक ऊंची संरचना): This refers to a very tall building or construction, which is not the correct meaning of "An ivory tower." • **Example:** The towering structure could be seen from miles away. 40:Ta74, The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. The ability to turn anything into gold.**
